articles.title: CrowdStrike Announces $500 Million Increase to Share Repurchase Program
articles.mainIdea: CrowdStrike Announces $500 Million Increase to Share Repurchase Program
articles.summary: Business Wire: CrowdStrike Announces $500 Million Increase to Share Repurchase Program. AUSTIN, Texas, April 06, 2026--CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWD) today announced that CrowdStrike’s Board of Directors has authorized the repurchase of up to an additional $500 million of CrowdStrike’s Class A common stock to its existing stock repurchase program, bringing the total authorization under the program to $1.5 billion.
